Usage: astryx doctor integration validate [options] [package]

Validate an integration manifest and its contributions

Arguments:
  package     Installed integration package name; omit to validate the package in the current directory.

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  no error-severity issues (warnings, including doc type findings, are allowed)
  1  one or more error-severity issues

Examples:
  # Validate the local package
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration validate
  # Validate an installed package
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration validate @acme/widgets --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/doctor-integration-validate
